analysis: The PR is documentation/comment-only. docs/provider/cli-reference.md adds a single row at head line 2206 (Watchdog crash restart: next check after outage seen, 1-2 min; defaultGraceSeconds=300 when continuing a crash-loop chain). provider-swift/Sources/ProviderCore/Config/ProviderConfig.swift line 23 changes only a doc comment from ~5 min to 1-2 min. No executable code, authorization, attestation, encryption or data-handling behavior changes. The rest of the cli-reference head text is unchanged context. Relevant threat: T-043 (watchdog rollback authority is the same replaceable binary, TB-003), T-046/T-047 related to restart/availability. The documented timing could be off relative to the actual WatchdogDecision.swift/WatchdogAgent.swift (checkIntervalSeconds=60, grace 300 on crash-loop chains); those sources are not in the supplied evidence, so documentation accuracy was not verified. The faster restart cadence is a documentation claim only; if an accompanying code change shortened the grace or loop guard (crashLoopTripThreshold=3), the next pass should confirm crash-loop guard and update-quarantine semantics (T-043) are unaffected. No new attack surface or invalidated threat assumptions identified within the supplied units.
